doc.brief: Describes the type of order that a `GtkSorter` may produce.
doc.md: Describes the type of order that a `GtkSorter` may produce.

none.brief: No order, all elements are considered equal. gtk_sorter_compare() will only return %GTK_ORDERING_EQUAL.
none.md:
No order, all elements are considered equal.
  gtk_sorter_compare() will only return %GTK_ORDERING_EQUAL.

partial.brief: A partial order. Any `GtkOrdering` is possible.
partial.md: A partial order. Any `GtkOrdering` is possible.

total.brief: A total order. gtk_sorter_compare() will only return %GTK_ORDERING_EQUAL if an item is compared with itself.
total.md:
A total order. gtk_sorter_compare() will only
  return %GTK_ORDERING_EQUAL if an item is compared with itself. Two
  different items will never cause this value to be returned.
